For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. May God be gracious to us and bless us, and cause His face to shine upon us, Selah
May God give us mercy and blessing, and let the light of his face be shining on us; (Selah.)
（一篇詩歌，交與伶長。用絲弦的樂器。）願神憐憫我們，賜福與我們，用臉光照我們，（細拉）
that Your ways may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.
So that men may see your way on the earth, and your salvation among all nations.
好叫世界得知你的道路，萬國得知你的救恩。
Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
Let the peoples give you praise, O God; let all the peoples give you praise.
神啊，願列邦稱讚你！願萬民都稱讚你！
Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for You judge the peoples justly and lead the nations of the earth. Selah
O let the nations be glad, and make song of joy; for you will be the judge of the peoples in righteousness, guiding the nations of the earth. (Selah.)
願萬國都快樂歡呼；因為你必按公正審判萬民，引導世上的萬國。（細拉）
Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
Let the peoples give you praise, O God; let all the peoples give you praise.
神啊，願列邦稱讚你！願萬民都稱讚你！
The earth has yielded its harvest; God, our God, blesses us.
The earth has given her increase; and God, even our God, will give us his blessing.
地已經出了土產；神─就是我們的神要賜福與我們。
God blesses us, that all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.
God will give us his blessing; so let all the ends of the earth be in fear of him.
神要賜福與我們；地的四極都要敬畏他！
